integrity: The primary full text and PDF pages containing Proposition 1.3 and Remark 3.2 were inspected. The trace asymptotic was reconstructed by a complete dyadic upper/lower estimate valid for all small radii, and the extension asymptotic follows from the source's vertical derivative bound plus Poisson-kernel contraction. No numerical experiment or finite enumeration is used.
scientific_limitations: The exact coefficient is proved for the source's explicit lacunary counterexample and is not claimed universal for all Zygmund traces or all vertically Lipschitz hyperbolic harmonic mappings. The extension modulus uses Euclidean distance on the closed upper half-space, not intrinsic hyperbolic distance. Classical lacunary-series literature creates a residual risk that the trace-only asymptotic was observed under different terminology.
title: Exact logarithmic modulus of the hyperbolic endpoint counterexample
